Understand WalletLedger in five minutes

A Telegram bot that keeps your expenses. You type Spent 450 on dinner via Bank, it records it, keeps your balances and draws charts. Click around: every box is a real file, described in plain words.

1. Only one file changes moneyThe ledger. Chat, AI, PDF import and the dashboard all ask it to.
2. Rules first, AI secondClear messages are read by built-in rules, instantly and free. The AI only handles what rules can't.
3. Identity is the chat idEvery row belongs to one Telegram chat. Nobody sees another chat's data.
Generated from the code by scripts/build_map.py. The same facts, as data, are in docs/project-map.json. Longer reading: docs/PROJECT_GUIDE.md.
